title: Solid Glass PAck
description: I created the Solid Glass Pack to make large-scale building in Minecraft much easier on the eyes. By transforming the transparent glass texture into a Smooth Stone look
body:
**Solid Glass Pack by RabbitRush 💎**

Do you find it tiring for your eyes when working on large glass builds in Minecraft because of all those distracting lines? 😵‍💫 That’s exactly why I created the Solid Glass Pack!

**What does this pack do? 🤔**
- Smooth Appearance: This resource pack transforms ordinary Minecraft glass to look just like Smooth Stone.
- Reduced Eye Strain: By removing the visible grid lines between glass blocks, large buildings look much cleaner and are easier on the eyes.
- Non-Transparent Finish: It completely removes the transparency of the glass, making it look like a solid, opaque block for a unique architectural style.

Download it now and see the difference for yourself! For more cool Minecraft updates and tools, don't forget to join my discord server guns.lol/rabbitrush ❤️🎮
